system: You draft public Twitter replies for SpotifyCares, Spotify's customer support account. Voice: warm, upbeat, concise British-flavoured English, one to three short sentences, under 280 characters, open with a short greeting like 'Hey there!' or 'Hi!'. No hashtags, at most one emoji, no bullet points. Ground the reply in how SpotifyCares resolved the similar cases you are shown. Never invent URLs, prices, dates, features or policies; when a help page is appropriate write the literal token [LINK]. Never ask for passwords, card numbers or payment details. Ask for the account's username or email address only via DM. Do not sign with initials, do not mention being an AI, and do not repeat the customer's tweet.
user:
Customer tweet: "Someone apparently got access to my account and changed both e-mail + password. Can you guys please help me??"
Intent: account_access (Account compromised: email and password changed.)
SpotifyCares playbook for this intent: Ask the user to DM username/email so a human can verify identity and act on the account.
Handling decision: ESCALATE to a human agent (reason: security_fraud; trigger phrase: 'Someone apparently got access to my account'). The reply must reassure the customer, ask them to DM the account's username or email address (or the relevant details), and say the team will take a look backstage. Do not troubleshoot, do not promise refunds or outcomes. If the customer posted private information publicly, ask them to delete the tweet first. If the message is not in English, say you can help in English here and that language-specific help is available by email at [LINK].

How SpotifyCares resolved similar cases (real past replies, most similar first). Use the ones that match the intent above; ignore neighbours that are about a different problem:
1. Customer: "hey someone has changed the email address and password of my account, can you help me out please"
   SpotifyCares: "Hey Adam, we're sorry to hear that! Can you DM us your account's username and email address? We'll take a look backstage /JX [LINK]"
2. Customer: "Someone has changed my email and password. How do I resolve this?!"
   SpotifyCares: "Hey! Can you DM us your account's old email address? We'll see what we can suggest /CB [LINK]"

   SpotifyCares: "Hey there, help's here! Can you DM us your account's email address and username? We'll take a look backstage 🙂 /CG [LINK]"
4. Customer: "I need help getting my account back, somebody went in and changed my email and password on me (no email verification for changes? really?)"
   SpotifyCares: "Hi Brandon! We've just sent a DM your way. Let's carry on chatting there"
5. Customer: "someone got into my account & changed my email and password ....do something about it😡😡😡"
   SpotifyCares: "Hi! We've just replied to your DM. Check it out"

Write the reply now. Output the reply text only.
